privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body:
AMESCOTES, Inc. (the 'Company') protects users' personal data under the Personal Information Protection Act of Korea.

1. What we collect and why

To receive and answer inquiries, we collect company name, name, phone, email, preferred production site, expected quantity, inquiry type and message. We use them for no other purpose.

2. Retention

Kept for 3 years after the inquiry is closed, then deleted without delay, unless the law requires longer.

3. Third parties

We do not share personal data with third parties without consent.

4. Processors

Email delivery of inquiries: FormSubmit · Website hosting: GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.)

5. Your rights

You may request access, correction, deletion or suspension at any time at contact@amescotes.co.kr.

6. Contact

AMESCOTES, Inc. · contact@amescotes.co.kr

Effective 19 October 2026

pps.title: PPS sampling.
pps.intro: Our stage-based PPS system checks design intent and structure at every step, cutting unnecessary sampling cost and time.
steps: Patterns are engineered in CAD, so revisions and grading move fast.
Size, proportion, silhouette and structure are checked in paper first.
Made in a similar material to fix texture such as wrinkles and slouch, plus the key details.
Made in the real material to confirm finish, material fit and production feasibility.
pps.old_note: Every change means another sample, so time and cost keep growing.
pps.new_note: Decisions are locked in paper and prototype, so the final sample lands in one go.
pps.claim: CAD instead of hand patterns, a paper mock-up before any sample. The final sample lands in one go.
why: Patterns are engineered in CAD, not drawn by hand.
Precise measurements keep left-right and size-to-size errors low
Patterns are kept as files and reused for revisions and reorders
Before any sample, we build the bag at full size in paper.
You check size and proportion in your hands
Fixes happen before leather is cut, so fewer samples are remade
The first form is ready in about three days
rows: First, in a paper mock-up (3 days~)
A new sample is made (2 weeks~)
Fixed at the mock-up and prototype stage

faq.title: FAQ.
items: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
From 50 pcs for production in Korea, and from 150 pcs for production in China.
How long does sampling take?
From about two weeks. Our in-house development team in Seoul makes the patterns and samples themselves, with nothing outsourced.
We don't have a professional designer or a detailed tech pack. Can you still make our product?

Yes, absolutely. Even without a formal tech pack, a physical sample you like, photos or a simple idea sketch is enough. Our specialists will work out the details with you, so feel free to get in touch.
What products do you make?
Bags, wallets, belts, keyrings, shoes and other small leather goods, plus living items such as trays and coasters, for luxury, premium, contemporary, wholesale and artist-merchandise lines.
Which materials do you work with?
Genuine leather, vegan leather, cotton, nylon, polyester, and special materials such as PVC.
Where is production done?

We develop in Seoul and produce in Korea, at our own factory in Qingdao, and with partner factories in Dongguan, Guangzhou and Yiwu. We recommend the location that fits your quantity, material and target cost.
How do you manage quality?
Production is managed to ISO 9001 and ISO 14001, inspected against our own standard, ASQ (Amescotes Standard Quality), and supported with after-sales service after delivery.
What do samples cost and what is the production lead time?
Both depend on the product and quantity, so we confirm them with your quote. Our PPS process fixes size and structure at the paper and toile stages, which cuts the number of samples and their cost.
Do you work with brands outside Korea?
Yes. We work with Japanese brands through our Japan subsidiary and supply distributors in China, Japan and Indonesia.
Our product was made at another factory, and the pattern and material details are unclear. Can you take it on?

Yes. Send us the existing product (a physical sample) and we will rebuild the pattern from it as new technical drawings, then source high-quality materials closest to the originals to recreate the same look and feel.
We saw a leather sample. Can it be made in fabric or synthetic leather instead?

Yes, of course. When the material changes, we redesign the internal reinforcement that holds the shape, along with the pattern, so the original design fit is kept. It also works the other way: fabric or synthetic leather products can be converted into premium leather.
How do I get started?
Use the contact form below or email contact@amescotes.co.kr with the product you have in mind, the expected quantity and your preferred production location.

make.title: How it's made.
b: We draft a pattern for every style, matched to the design and the target cost.
Leather and trims are sourced through our network in Korea and abroad.
Leather is cut to the pattern and skived to the right thickness.
Our in-house sample room builds and revises each sample directly.
An experienced sewing team sets the structure and the finish.
Volume production on our lines in Korea or China.
Every piece is checked against our own ASQ standard.
Carefully packed and shipped to Korea and overseas.
s: The last and the design set the silhouette and the fit.
Upper patterns are graded size by size to the last.
Materials are cut to the pattern and sorted by part.
Pieces are stitched and reinforced to build the upper.
The upper is pulled over the last to take its shape.
The outsole is pressed and bonded on.
Symmetry and finish are checked pair by pair.
Boxed and shipped to Korea and overseas.
